title: Politicians’ Ideology, State Intervention, and Corporate Taxation
authors: Na Ke; Terry J. Shevlin; Danqing Wang; Wenjia Yan
eligible_reason: Table 4 column 1 regresses firm ETR on the binary city-secretary ideology indicator sgaige with firm FE and province x year FE, no controls, clustered by city (MScode.do line 226). sgaige switches on at city-specific secretary-turnover years (first switch-on years span 2002-2016 across 221 cities, with 18 never-treated and 31 always-treated cities). Treatment can switch off (67 cities revert at least once); per PROTOCOL Sec. 5b, post-adoption periods with treatment off are dropped. All other columns and tables add time-varying controls.
design_notes: Firm-year panel of Chinese listed firms 2002-2016 (maindata.dta; CSMAR financials merged with hand-collected city secretary biographies). Treatment is a city-level attribute of the incumbent secretary (joined CPC after 1978). Specs: areg etr i.provyear sgaige [controls], absorb(stkcd) cluster(citycode); Table 4 col 4 uses a matched sample with pair x year FE; Table 5 regresses changes in ETR around turnovers on changes in ideology (cross-section); Tables 6-8 heterogeneity and mechanisms with controls; Table 3 validates the ideology measure with speech text. Shipped data drop secretaries who are current Politburo members and de-identify names/provinces/cities ('results remain largely unaffected').
estimators_reported: TWFE static (firm FE + province x year FE; areg)
matched-sample DiD with pair x year FE

specs.treatment_definition: sgaige = 1 if the city party secretary in office in year t joined the Communist Party after 1978 (weak communist ideology), 0 otherwise; city-level, switches at secretary turnover years and can revert (weak -> strong); applied to all listed firms headquartered in the city
specs.fe: stkcd (areg absorb) + provyear (province x year dummies, i.provyear)
specs.sample_condition: maindata.dta: 17,740 firm-years, 2,327 firms, 221 cities, 27 provinces, 2002-2016 (shipped file excludes secretaries now on the Politburo)
specs.notes: areg etr i.provyear sgaige, absorb(stkcd) robust cluster(citycode). Province x year FE = time-invariant group x calendar-time FE (allowed). City-level switching pattern in shipped data: 105 cities switch 0->1 once and stay, 67 cities switch both ways or revert, 31 always treated, 18 never treated; first switch-on years 2002-2016. Reversals require dropping post-switch-off observations (Hull fn 6).

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (secretary characteristics; firm and city controls)
specs.controls: sage sedu sprom sfemale swenge (col 2) + eage eedu size mb roa lev intan ppe eincome foreign nol soe gdpgrow (col 3)

specs.exclusion_reason: matched sample with pair x year FE and full controls
all columns include time-varying controls; Table 5 is a cross-sectional changes regression; Table 3/probit validation
specs.outcome: etr, taxbdum, taxb, taxavoid, ssdum, numaudit

data_files: T3speech.dta, T4C4matched.dta, T5change.dta, T7PAtaxb.dta, T7PCC2.dta, T8PAturnover.dta, T8PBmlogit.dta (table-specific files)

balincf.dta, balincfp.dta, ceoinfo.dta, secpref.dta, femalesecpref.dta, gdp.dta, soe.dta, stkcity.dta, ataxrate.dta, smalltax.dta, govfin.dta, pop.dta, idChange.dta, liberationprov.dta, bjob.dta, fincome02-16.dta (inputs)
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Switching pattern computed read-only from maindata.dta (city-year means of sgaige). Treatment is an incumbent characteristic rather than a policy, and a large always-treated share (31/221 cities) plus reversals should be noted in estimation.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: First switch-on years 2003-2016 for cities not treated at sample start (2003:17, 2004:18, 2005:7, 2006:11, 2007:21, 2008:9, 2009:23, 2010:12, 2011:3, 2012:14, 2013:6, 2014:7, 2015:2, 2016:8); 45 cities treated in 2002 (first year) of which 31 remain always treated.
data_files_note: Real data but with Politburo-member secretaries removed and identifiers anonymized; published estimates will differ slightly.
priority_note: One eligible main-text spec (Table 4 col 1); data shipped; expect approximate replication because of the disclosed sample exclusion. No logs or output tables in the package, so published coefficients must be read from the article.
